provenance.method: Atomic claims synthesized conservatively from current consensus standards and authoritative civil/structural/geotechnical references. The corpus models civil engineering as a coupled design problem in which loads, material behavior, geometry and ground conditions jointly determine feasible works and performance checks.

warnings: The expression charge × matériau × géométrie × sol → ouvrage is a conceptual coupling, not a literal algebraic equation.
Design loads, factors and acceptance criteria are jurisdiction- and code-dependent; this corpus does not encode project-specific numerical design values.
Material properties are condition-, test- and specification-dependent; generic referents must not be substituted for certified project data.
Soil and rock are spatially variable; site investigation observations are local evidence rather than complete descriptions of a site.
The corpus is encyclopedic and not a substitute for licensed engineering design, code compliance review, site investigation or construction quality assurance.
